entity_description: i53 mRNA is a synthetic messenger RNA designed to inhibit 53BP1, thereby promoting HDR over NHEJ in gene editing applications.
GSE56 mRNA is another synthetic messenger RNA used in combination with i53 mRNA to further enhance HDR efficiency in gene editing.
AZD7648 is a small-molecule inhibitor that targets DNA-PKcs, a key enzyme in the NHEJ pathway. It is used to inhibit NHEJ and promote HDR in gene editing.
Recombinant Adeno-Associated Virus serotype 6 (rAAV6) templates are viral vectors used to deliver DNA templates for HDR in gene editing applications.
